deliverables.name: Epic folder structure implementation
deliverables.description: Create proper epic → feature → phase hierarchy

deliverables.name: Folder naming conventions
deliverables.description: Implement suffix naming with 25 char limit

success_criteria: Epic has features/ subfolder with full feature plans
Features have phases/ subfolder with executable phases
All naming follows suffix pattern (cortex5-epic, not epic-cortex5)

deliverables.name: JSON-based feature plans
deliverables.description: Replace .md feature files with executable JSON plans

deliverables.name: Progress tracker format v2
deliverables.description: Enhanced tracker with snowball execution order

deliverables.name: Phase execution manifests
deliverables.description: Machine-readable phase definitions for autonomous execution

success_criteria: Zero .md files in features/ folder (except in context/analysis subfolders)
Plan viewer can parse and display JSON plans

deliverables.name: Epic vs Feature detection
deliverables.description: Auto-detect mode based on features/ subfolder + epic-progress-tracker.json

deliverables.name: Plan viewer mode switcher
deliverables.description: Universal viewer that renders epic or feature based on detection

success_criteria: Plan viewer correctly detects epic vs feature 100% of time
Epic mode renders all features with progress bars
Feature mode renders all phases with progress bars

deliverables.name: Autonomous continuation
deliverables.description: Auto-execute next phase after completion (no manual trigger)

success_criteria: Features execute in optimal snowball order
Parallel execution works without race conditions
Autonomous mode completes entire epic without user intervention
Progress tracking accurate across concurrent executions
